```{r}
### CLEAN DATA FOR THE KRIGGING ###
prepare_school_kriging_data <- function(
  excel_path,
  sheet = 2,
  shp_path,
  region_name = NULL,          # NULL => area which you want to apply the krigging
  region_field = "NAME_1",
  cell = 5000,
  target_epsg = 2157,
  min_points = 10
) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(excel_path), file.exists(shp_path))

  schools_df <- read_excel(excel_path, sheet = sheet) %>%
    rename(
      longitude = `School Longitude`,
      latitude  = `School Latitude`
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) %>%
    mutate(enrolment = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Enrolment per Return`))) %>%
    filter(is.finite(enrolment), enrolment > 0) %>%
    mutate(log_enrol = log(enrolment)) %>%
    filter(is.finite(log_enrol))

  ireland_counties <- sf::st_read(shp_path, quiet = TRUE)

  if (is.null(region_name)) {
    region_sf <- st_union(sf::st_transform(ireland_counties, target_epsg)) %>%
      st_as_sf() %>%
      mutate(id = 1)
  } else {
    region_sf <- ireland_counties %>%
      filter(.data[[region_field]] == region_name) %>%
      st_transform(target_epsg) %>%
      st_union() %>%
      st_as_sf() %>%
      mutate(id = 1)
  }

  schools_sf <- st_as_sf(
    schools_df,
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%st_transform(target_epsg)

  schools_region_sf <- schools_sf[region_sf, ] %>%filter(is.finite(log_enrol))

  schools_sp <- as(schools_region_sf, "Spatial")

  df_sp <- as.data.frame(schools_sp)
  xy <- coordinates(schools_sp)
  df_sp$x <- xy[, 1]
  df_sp$y <- xy[, 2]

  schools_agg_df <- df_sp %>%
    group_by(x, y) %>%
    summarise(log_enrol = mean(log_enrol, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  coordinates(schools_agg_df) <- ~ x + y
  proj4string(schools_agg_df) <- proj4string(schools_sp)

  if (nrow(as.data.frame(schools_agg_df)) <= min_points) {
    stop("Not enough points after filtering/aggregation. Increase area or lower min_points.")
  }

  grid_polys <- st_make_grid(region_sf, cellsize = cell, what = "polygons")
  grid_polys <- st_sf(id = seq_along(grid_polys), geometry = grid_polys)
  grid_polys <- st_filter(grid_polys, region_sf, .predicate = sf::st_intersects)

  if (nrow(grid_polys) == 0) stop("Grid has 0 cells after intersecting region.")

  grid_centroids_sf <- st_centroid(grid_polys)
  grid_centroids_sp <- as(grid_centroids_sf, "Spatial")

  list(
    region_sf = region_sf,
    schools_agg_sp = schools_agg_df,           
    schools_agg_sf = st_as_sf(schools_agg_df),
    grid_polys_sf = grid_polys,                
    grid_centroids_sp = grid_centroids_sp     
  )
}


## Kriging function ##
run_enrolment_kriging <- function(
  schools_agg_sp,
  grid_centroids_sp,
  grid_polys_sf = NULL,   
  width,
  cutoff,
  vgm_start,
  nmax = 100,
  nmin = 1,
  maxdist = 1e6
) {
  # Empirical variogram
  v <- variogram(log_enrol ~ 1, data = schools_agg_sp, width = width, cutoff = cutoff)

  # Fit model
  fv <- fit.variogram(v, vgm_start)

  # Ordinary kriging
  kriged_sp <- krige(
    log_enrol ~ 1,
    locations = schools_agg_sp,
    newdata   = grid_centroids_sp,
    model     = fv,
    nmax      = nmax,
    nmin      = nmin,
    maxdist   = maxdist
  )

  kriged_sp$enrol_pred <- exp(kriged_sp$var1.pred)
  kriged_sf <- st_as_sf(kriged_sp)

  if (!is.null(grid_polys_sf)) {
    grid_out <- grid_polys_sf
    grid_out$enrol_pred <- kriged_sf$enrol_pred
    grid_out$krig_var   <- kriged_sf$var1.var
  } else {
    grid_out <- NULL
  }

  list(
    variogram = v,
    variogram_model = fv,
    kriged_points_sf = kriged_sf,
    grid_polys_sf = grid_out
  )
}
```


```{r}
dat_irl <- prepare_school_kriging_data(
  excel_path = "../data/Data_on_Individual_Schools_Mainstream_2024_25.xlsx",
  sheet = 2,
  shp_path = "../data/gadm41_IRL_shp/gadm41_IRL_2.shp",
  region_name = NULL,
  cell = 5000,
  min_points = 50
)

res_irl <- run_enrolment_kriging(
  schools_agg_sp     = dat_irl$schools_agg_sp,
  grid_centroids_sp  = dat_irl$grid_centroids_sp,
  grid_polys_sf      = dat_irl$grid_polys_sf,
  width  = 5000,
  cutoff = 200000,
  vgm_start = gstat::vgm(psill = 0.8, model = "Exp", range = 80000, nugget = 0.1),
  nmax = 150
)

res_irl
```


```{r}
# 1) Read Small Areas (change path to your file)
sa <- st_read("../data/Small_Area_National_Statistical_Boundaries_2022.geojson", quiet = TRUE)

# 2) Choose an ID column if it exists; otherwise create one
id_candidates <- c("GEOGID","SA_GUID","SAID","SA_ID","SMALL_AREA","OBJECTID","FID")
sa_id <- id_candidates[id_candidates %in% names(sa)][1]

if (is.na(sa_id)) {
  sa <- sa %>% mutate(sa_uid = row_number())
  sa_id <- "sa_uid"
}

# 3) Ensure same CRS as your kriging grid (yours is EPSG:2157) + valid geometry
grid <- st_make_valid(res_irl$grid_polys_sf)
sa   <- st_make_valid(st_transform(sa, st_crs(grid)))

# 4) Keep only needed columns (faster)
grid_keep <- grid %>% select(enrol_pred, krig_var)
sa_keep   <- sa   %>% select(all_of(sa_id))

# 5) Intersect + area-weighted mean per Small Area
inter <- st_intersection(sa_keep, grid_keep) %>%
  mutate(w = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)))  # area weights

agg <- inter %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(.data[[sa_id]]) %>%
  summarise(
    krig_value = weighted.mean(enrol_pred, w = w, na.rm = TRUE),
    krig_var   = weighted.mean(krig_var,   w = w, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 6) Attach ONE value per Small Area
sa_with_krig <- sa %>% left_join(agg, by = setNames(sa_id, sa_id))

ggplot(sa_with_krig |> st_drop_geometry(), aes(x = krig_value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of aggregated kriging values (Small Areas)",
    x = "Kriging value (log10 scale)",
    y = "Count of Small Areas"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
```{r}
urb_rural_df <- read_csv("../data/SAPS_2022_Small_Area_UR_171024.csv")%>%mutate(
    category = str_extract(UR_Category_Desc, "(?<=\\.).*"))%>%select("GEOGID","category")%>%distinct()%>%  mutate(
    urban_rural = case_when(
      category %in% c(
        " Cities",
        " Satellite Urban Towns",
        " Independent urban towns"
      ) ~ "Urban",
      
      category %in% c(
        " Rural areas with high urban influence",
        " Rural areas with moderate urban influence",
        " Highly rural/remote areas"
      ) ~ "Rural",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  rename(SA_PUB2022 = GEOGID)


###JOIN:

sa_with_krig <- sa_with_krig %>%
  mutate(SA_PUB2022 = as.character(SA_PUB2022))

urb_rural_df <- urb_rural_df %>%
  mutate(SA_PUB2022 = as.character(SA_PUB2022))

sa_with_krig_ur <- sa_with_krig %>%
  left_join(urb_rural_df %>% select(SA_PUB2022, category, urban_rural),
            by = "SA_PUB2022")
```


```{r}
plot_df <- sa_with_krig_ur %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(urban_rural), is.finite(krig_value), krig_value > 0)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = krig_value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ urban_rural, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of aggregated kriging values (Small Areas) by Urban/Rural",
    x = "Kriging value (log10 scale)",
    y = "Count of Small Areas"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r}
age_df <- read_csv("../data/SAPS_2022_Small_Area_UR_171024.csv")%>%
  rename(SA_PUB2022 = GEOGID)

to_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(as.numeric(x))
  readr::parse_number(as.character(x))
}


target_ages <- 3:18

target_cols <- paste0("T1_1AGE", target_ages, "T")
target_cols <- intersect(target_cols, names(age_df))
stopifnot(length(target_cols) > 0)


age_norm_target <- age_df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(target_cols), to_num)) %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(target_cols),
    ~ {
      denom <- sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)     # column total across all Small Areas
      if (is.na(denom) || denom == 0) NA_real_ else .x / denom
    },
    .names = "{.col}_share"
  )) %>%
  transmute(
    SA_PUB2022,
    # normalised target pop = sum of the normalised (share) columns
    target_pop_norm = rowSums(across(ends_with("_share")), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

sa_full_norm <- sa_with_krig_ur %>%
  mutate(SA_PUB2022 = str_trim(as.character(SA_PUB2022))) %>%
  left_join(age_norm_target, by = "SA_PUB2022") %>%
  st_transform(2157) %>%
  mutate(
    area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6,
    # density from kriging value (per km²)
    places_density_km2 = krig_value / area_km2,
    # NORMALISED by target_pop_norm
    dens_norm = places_density_km2 / target_pop_norm,
    dens_norm_per_1000 = 1000 * dens_norm
  )
```


```{r}
plot_df_norm <- sa_full_norm %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(urban_rural),
    is.finite(dens_norm_per_1000),
    dens_norm_per_1000 > 0,
    is.finite(target_pop_norm),
    target_pop_norm > 0
  )

ggplot(plot_df_norm, aes(x = dens_norm_per_1000)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ urban_rural, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "School place density (kriging) normalised by target population (ages ",
      min(target_ages), "–", max(target_ages), ")\n",
      "Target population normalised by COLUMN totals"
    ),
    x = "Normalised density × 1000 (log10 scale)",
    y = "Count of Small Areas"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
